metadata.name: CORE — Shared audit finding
metadata.usage: Every auditor uses this shape. Do not redefine it inside an agent.

campos.campo: severity: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or INFO
evidence: file and line, redacted command output, or reproduction. CONFIRMED requires evidence.

reglas.regla: Store findings incrementally in docs/qa/. Reference them from the fix register and the pipeline report.
Distinguish a confirmed defect, an inferred risk, and a pending clarification.
Redact secrets, tokens, personal data, emails, hostnames, and connection strings before writing.
Do not include a working exploit.
